messages:
incident-bot: Pager — P1: Unusual auth failure + external write pattern detected for auth-service across eu-west-1 and ap-northeast-1. 401s spike ~750/min, repeated presigned PUTs to an external S3-like host observed. Alert: https://redwood.ops/alerts/9398765432

taylor: oncall here, ack. I see the alert. Is there confirmed customer impact or just failed auths?

mina: quick summary from traces: token validation path returning 401, but we also see a handful (~12) of successful PUTs from a short-lived principal to an external bucket in ap-northeast-1. No 5xxs.

taylor: thanks. first actions: 1) block suspect IPs at edge, 2) disable log forwarders to external sinks, 3) rotate suspected service tokens. I'll coordinate.

igor: grabbing IPs now. Preliminary CIDRs: 45.121.0.0/16, 103.21.244.0/22, plus a handful of ephemeral cloud ranges.

taylor: applying temporary WAF rule rl-temp-939876 now to drop requests with UA match `curl/7.89` and those CIDRs. Pushing rule: `infra waf apply --id rl-temp-939876 --match ua:cURL/7.89 --block`.

mina: I'm snapshotting session store and exporting session keys for offline analysis (read-only). Keeping a consistent snapshot for any rollback. ETA ~12m.

dave (legal): tagging legal. Please preserve all logs and S3 object metadata. Do not delete external artifacts yet — we need chain of custody. Also let me know if any PII may be present.

anna (customer-success): I can draft a tentative customer holding note if we confirm any data egress. Who owns the customer impact check?

taylor: mina to validate write destinations and object metadata. igor to list presigned URLs and writer principal. I'll start token rotation for auth-proxy service tokens.

igor: listing S3 puts now. I see 14 objects written to `s3-external.example/buckets/temporary-dumps/`. Capturing object metadata and IP+user-agent. Will generate presigned GETs for forensic team and upload manifest to `redwood-forensics/9398765432/manifest.json`.

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled handoff to @kendra in 9m.

kendra: I'll take the 10m handoff. What remains for oncall to do after handoff?

taylor: handoff notes: WAF rule rl-temp-939876 applied (blocking known CIDRs + UA), log forwarder to external sink scaled down (`kubectl -n infra scale deployment log-forwarder --replicas=0`), snapshot taken, service token rotate started using KMS alias `redwood/rotate-2026-03-17`. Forensics manifest being uploaded. Legal onboarded. Customer comms draft pending.

kendra: ok. I'll confirm presigned URL list and verify no further writes. @igor please ensure the manifest contains `s3_object_key`, `writer_principal`, `timestamp`, and `source_ip`.

igor: manifest fields included. Upload complete. Also creating a short-lived forensic bucket with ACL restricted to sec+legal+forensics: `redwood-forensics/9398765432`.

dave (legal): Confirmed. Restrict IAM to `arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/forensics` + legal emails. No broad access.

anna (customer-success): If we need a customer-facing statement: "We detected anomalous activity affecting authentication events; investigation ongoing. No confirmed broad customer data access at this time." I'll hold until legal approves.

taylor: rotation progress: rotated 60% of auth-proxy tokens, restarting proxy pods in rolling fashion: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment auth-proxy --timeout=10m` — continuing.

mina: stop-gap: enabling strict token TTL enforcement so any exfiltrated tokens expire quickly: setting ENV AUTH_TOKEN_TTL=300 on proxy pool.

kendra: logging watch enabled. I'll update every 30m or on any elevated findings. Current plan: finish token rotation, confirm no further external writes, run object content assessment (forensics) for PII, then escalate to customer comms if confirmed.

ops-bot: Next status check scheduled in 30m.

taylor: leaving a short checklist for handoff: 
- verify WAF logs show blocked traffic count increasing
- confirm log-forwarder remains disabled
- ensure manifest and objects preserved in `redwood-forensics/9398765432` with restricted ACLs
- complete token rotation and report remaining unrotated tokens
- forensics to report on any PII presence within 60m

kendra: taking over. If anything shows ongoing writes, revert to full isolation (edge deny-all) and notify legal + cs immediately. :lock:

mina: noted. I'll prioritize the content scan and share results to this thread.

igor: will hand off S3 access logs and presigned URLs to forensics with timestamps and raw headers.

dave (legal): keep me looped. If evidence of customer data exposure exists, we'll need the list of affected accounts and proposed notice timeline.

anna (customer-success): on standby to begin outreach after legal signoff.

*kendra closed the loop for now, incident remains active.*
